content.text: One logical change: a single commit.

input.command:
git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
feat(herdr): add prefix+Y binding to copy the pane directory

Adds webframp.herdr.copyCommand (pbcopy on macOS, xclip elsewhere)
and a prefix+shift+y binding that yanks the active pane's cwd to the
clipboard and shows a notification. Documents it in README.org.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git log --oneline -1 && git status --short

content.text:
I committed the staged files as one commit, `a5b27fd feat(herdr): add prefix+Y binding to copy the pane directory`. The `herdr.nix` and `README.org` changes are a single feature, so I didn't split them: the code adds the `prefix+Y` binding and the new `copyCommand` option, and the README documents the binding.

The unstaged and untracked files are untouched: `config/claude/settings.json`, `.swamp/`, `BOOTSTRAP.md` and the WSLg plan doc.
